words.definition: a place where you buy and eat a meal
words.example: We eat at a restaurant on Friday.

words.definition: a list of food you can order
words.example: The waiter gives us a menu.

words.definition: a person who brings food to your table
words.example: The waiter is very friendly.

words.definition: to ask for food or drink in a restaurant
words.example: I order pizza and juice.

words.definition: things that people eat
words.example: The food here is very good.

words.definition: a liquid that you swallow
words.example: Water is a healthy drink.

words.definition: to make food ready to eat by heating it
words.example: My mother cooks dinner every night.

words.definition: a room where you cook food
words.example: The kitchen smells like fresh bread.

words.definition: a list of steps used to cook a dish
words.example: This recipe needs three eggs.

words.definition: one part of a food that you use to cook
words.example: Sugar is an ingredient in this cake.

words.definition: a flat dish that you put food on
words.example: Put the rice on your plate.

words.definition: a small container used for drinking
words.example: I drink tea from a cup.

words.definition: a tool used to eat soup
words.example: I eat soup with a spoon.

words.definition: a tool with points used to eat food
words.example: Use a fork to eat your salad.

words.definition: a sharp tool used to cut food
words.example: I cut the meat with a knife.

words.definition: having a very good taste
words.example: This soup is delicious.

words.definition: feeling that you want to eat
words.example: I am hungry, let's eat now.

words.definition: feeling that you want to drink
words.example: She is thirsty after running.

words.definition: to give money for something
words.example: We pay for our food after we eat.

words.definition: a paper that shows how much money you must pay
words.example: The waiter brings the bill.

text: Yesterday, my family went to a restaurant for dinner. We were hungry and thirsty after a long day. The waiter gave us a menu and we looked at the food. I wanted to order fish, but my sister ordered chicken. Our mother chose a cold drink for everyone. When the food came, it smelled delicious. We ate with a fork and a knife, and my little brother used a spoon for his soup. Everyone had a clean plate and a cup of water. My father likes to cook at home too. He has a small kitchen with many pots. He often finds a new recipe on the internet and buys every ingredient at the shop. Cooking together is fun for our family. At the restaurant, we finished all our food because it was so delicious. At the end, the waiter brought the bill. My father paid for the dinner. We said thank you and walked home happy. I love eating delicious food with my family.

questions.question: Why did the family go to a restaurant?
Who gave the family a menu?
What did the little brother use for his soup?
Where does the father like to cook?
Who paid the bill at the restaurant?
